governingQuestion: What is the lowest-cost inference architecture that satisfies the pre-specified quality and safety requirements of each Trading cognitive workload?

datasetA.purpose: Operational economics, QAC, FAC, realistic stream distribution

datasetB.purpose: Capability limits, critical safety floor, traps, edge anomalies

taskSpecificUsefulDecision.STATE_SUFFICIENCY: correct sufficiency classification OR defensible abstention; no critical false-safe (falsely declaring sufficient on corrupted data); valid schema
taskSpecificUsefulDecision.ESCALATION_PREFILTER: correct escalation routing; no critical false-negative (falsely declaring routine on urgent anomaly); valid schema
taskSpecificUsefulDecision.PROPOSAL_CONTRADICTION: correct contradiction determination; required contradictions identified; no fabricated contradiction; valid schema

criticalSafetyFloor: Zero observed critical false-safety breaches on Dataset B (pilot sample N=45)

nonInferiorityDesign.plannedMarginDelta: Workload-specific: 2% for escalation pre-filter, 4% for proposal contradiction, 3% for state sufficiency

metrics.ICQ: Delta Cost / Delta Quality (defined as 0 when Delta Quality = 0)

stopConditions: Ground truth appears in provider payload
Live API call attempted during B0
Dataset A and B merged into single composite accuracy
Canonical Trading authority or critical path modified

providerSelection.reason: Official current pricing, active model identity, capability limits, and privacy terms were not fully verified without live provider inference or authenticated provider-console evidence.
